name: mnemonic_decay_clock
label: The Looming Dissolution
godotFeature: Godot's Physics Engine (RigidBody dynamics, CollisionShape updates)
poeticVision: The player will feel an ever-present, suffocating dread as the very ground beneath Lyra's feet literally dissolves and shifts into oblivion. Each second spent is a second lost, not just to the Silence, but to the memory itself unraveling. It’s a desperate race against an existential clock, where the environment is Lyra's rapidly fading past, actively collapsing around her, forcing split-second choices and amplifying the terror of self-loss.

parameters.name: decay_interval
parameters.description: The time in seconds between each environmental piece decaying.

parameters.name: total_decay_duration
parameters.description: The total conceptual time until all memories (decayable areas) are gone. Currently used for progress tracking, not direct timing of all decays.

parameters.name: decay_root_path
parameters.description: The NodePath to a Node3D that contains all the RigidBody3D nodes intended to decay.

parameters.name: dissolve_shader_material_template
parameters.description: A ShaderMaterial resource that uses the dissolve_shader.gdshader. This template will be duplicated and applied to each decaying MeshInstance3D.

verdict: The very ground beneath Lyra's feet becomes a ticking clock of existential dread, making the loss of self a tangible, crumbling reality.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally transform the player's experience by turning the environment itself into a relentless, physical manifestation of Lyra's fading identity. Every step becomes a desperate gamble against oblivion, forcing constant movement and amplifying the core themes of self-loss and urgent survival. The player will feel an inescapable, suffocating dread as their past literally crumbles beneath their feet, making the abstract threat of forgetting terrifyingly real and immediate.
